question: Do the Action Plan and the MPRs address all potential pollution contributors on the Kabini stretch?
intro: The Kabini's CPCB polluted stretch runs from Saragur village downstream to the T. Narasipura water-supply intake - 104.3 km at Priority V since CPCB redrew it in October 2025, where it was the 9 km below Nanjangud at Priority IV in 2018. This section compares the KSPCB Action Plan's commitments with what the monthly progress reports actually report. 'Not reported' means absent from the documents, not necessarily absent on the ground.

primary.label: NMCG Monthly Progress Report (Karnataka, Kabini stretch)
primary.note: September 2025 is the last stretch-wise MPR edition. April 2026 annexures provide the latest STP and water-quality status.

actionPlan.label: KSPCB Action Plan for Rejuvenation of River Kabini

baseline.banner: September 2025 is the last stretch-wise MPR edition; from October 2025 the format drops per-stretch narrative, and by April 2026 the MPR carries only state-wide annexure tables (station classes, STP lists). Accountability below anchors on the September 2025 stretch-wise reporting, with April 2026's annexures as the latest outcome data. The September edition repeats the August position; the figures below are unchanged between them.
otherSources: NMCG MPR April 2026 - annexure tables only (station water-quality classes + state-wide STP lists); no per-stretch narrative
Revised District Environmental Plan of Mysuru District (May 2022) - the only source that reports Sargur and T. Narasipura, the two towns the October-2025 redraw added to the stretch

solid-waste.label: NGT OA 606/2018 - SWM Rules compliance (Justice Subhash B Adi committee)

biomedical.label: NGT OA 710/2017 - BMW Rules 2016 (KSPCB guidelines hub)

fecal-sludge.label: SC (2017) 5 SCC 326 - mandatory sewage treatment infrastructure; NGT OA 673/2018 monitoring

public-stps.label: SC (2017) 5 SCC 326 - mandatory treatment infrastructure; NGT OA 673/2018 monthly reporting

effluent.label: Water Act consent regime; KSPCB hazardous waste management

regions.name: Sargur (TP)
regions.inBasinNote: Town Panchayat at the head of the 2025 stretch. CPCB's first monitoring point on the reach, 'Kabini at Saragur village D/S', already reads BOD 4 mg/L.

categories.label: Public STPs

actionPlan.summary: The Action Plan names Nanjangud as the only local body on the river - 'CMC Nanjangudu is the only local body located on the bank of the river Kabini' (p.3), written when the stretch was the 9 km below the town.

mpr.summary: Not itemised in any edition through September 2025 - the Kabini stretch section covered Nanjangud only.

gaps: Revised District Environmental Plan of Mysuru District (May 2022) puts the town's sewage at 1.2339 MLD with no sewerage network, no treatment, and no facility marked as planned in its STP-requirement table. It is the only source that reports the town at all.
Sargur has sat at the head of the polluted stretch since CPCB redrew it in October 2025, and has never appeared in a progress report.

categories.label: Solid Waste

actionPlan.summary: No solid-waste commitment for Sargur appears in the Action Plan.

mpr.summary: Not reported in any edition through September 2025.

gaps: The district plan reports 4.57 TPD generated across 12 wards, 10 of them at 100% source segregation (pp.8-9); waste destinations are not reported.
Solid waste for Sargur appears in neither the Action Plan nor the MPRs - the reporting gap is the finding.

categories.label: Biomedical Waste

actionPlan.summary: Biomedical waste does not appear in the Kabini Action Plan.
actionPlan.cite: Kabini Action Plan (full text, zero mentions)

mpr.summary: No biomedical-waste reporting for Sargur in any edition through September 2025; the stretch section's figure covers Nanjangud only.

gaps: No known public biomedical-waste figure for this town.

categories.label: Fecal Sludge

actionPlan.summary: Faecal sludge and septage do not appear in the Action Plan.

mpr.summary: Not reported in any edition through September 2025.

gaps: With no sewerage network at all, the whole of the town's sewage takes an unreported septage or surface route to the river, at the head of the polluted stretch.

mpr.summary: No private STP reporting for Sargur in any edition through September 2025.

regions.name: Nanjangud (CMC)
regions.inBasinNote: The stretch ULB - population 50,137; the temple town and its industrial belt sit at the head of the polluted reach.

categories.label: Public STPs

actionPlan.summary: 100% UGD for the entire town and a terminal STP treating to CPCB standards.

mpr.summary: August 2025 repeats the June position verbatim - 7 MLD STP operational, only 2 MLD utilised against 5.41 MLD generated, 60% household connections, Rs 36.86 crore DPR 'under completion stage' against a completion timeline still printed as 31-03-2021 - but adds a real development: consent to establish for the upgraded 8 MLD STP obtained 31/07/2025 (CTE-349927, valid to 2030), upgradation 'at completion stage'. April 2026's STP annexure then lists the Goluru plant as 8 MLD SBT, operational and complying, utilisation up from 2 to 3.5 MLD.

gaps: The network is still the bottleneck: even at 3.5 MLD utilised (April 2026), 1.9 MLD of the town's sewage goes untreated, and the UGD completion timeline has been printed as 31-03-2021 in every edition for four years.
Outcome check: August 2025 samples at the three Kabini stations read Class B/C, but April 2026 classifies both reported stations Class D (BOD ~4 mg/L).

categories.label: Solid Waste

actionPlan.summary: The plan itself records ~20 TPD generation and that despite an MSW site existing, some waste is dumped on the river banks - with disposal only at the MSW site committed.

mpr.summary: August 2025: 26 TPD generated, ~6 TPD composted (composting gap 4.66 TPD, landfill gap 6.24 TPD); Rs 5.16 crore DPR for a sanitary landfill approved, construction 'in progress'; door-to-door in all 31 wards, source segregation in 24; proposed-facility timeline still printed 31.03.2021.

gaps: Processing covers roughly a quarter of generation; the bank-dumping the plan acknowledged has no explicit closure status in the MPRs.
Bulk waste generators and waste destinations are not itemised.

categories.label: Biomedical Waste

actionPlan.summary: Biomedical waste does not appear in the Kabini Action Plan.
actionPlan.cite: Kabini Action Plan (full text, zero mentions)

mpr.summary: 0.217 kg/day reported across 35 bedded and 50 non-bedded health-care facilities; disposal via CBMWTF. Unchanged through the August 2025 edition.

gaps: The reported generation figure (0.217 kg/day for 85 facilities) is implausibly low as stated - likely a units error in the MPR itself; no facility-level trail to check it against.

categories.label: Fecal Sludge

actionPlan.summary: Faecal sludge and septage do not appear in the Action Plan.

mpr.summary: With 40% of households unconnected to the UGD, their septage route is not reported in any edition through September 2025.

gaps: The unsewered share's septage is the unaccounted flow between the town and the river.

mpr.summary: No private STP reporting for Nanjangud in any edition through September 2025.

regions.name: T. Narasipura (TMC)
regions.inBasinNote: Town Municipal Council at the foot of the 2025 stretch. The reach ends at this town's water-supply intake, the worst monitored point on the river - BOD 6 mg/L in both the 2022-23 and 2024 CPCB rounds.

categories.label: Public STPs

actionPlan.summary: The Action Plan names Nanjangud as the only local body on the river - 'CMC Nanjangudu is the only local body located on the bank of the river Kabini' (p.3), written when the stretch was the 9 km below the town.

mpr.summary: Not itemised in any edition through September 2025, though the stretch now ends at this town's water-supply intake.

gaps: Revised District Environmental Plan of Mysuru District (May 2022) puts the town's sewage at 3.401784 MLD with UGD covering half its area, and contradicts itself on treatment: an existing 5.5 MLD STP on pp.57 and 60, but 0 MLD in the capacity table on p.59. Treated volume is not reported in any edition.
The stretch's worst BOD is measured at this town's water-supply intake, and no progress report has ever covered the town.

categories.label: Solid Waste

actionPlan.summary: No solid-waste commitment for T. Narasipura appears in the Action Plan.

mpr.summary: Not reported in any edition through September 2025.

gaps: The district plan reports 13 TPD across 23 wards, 22 of them at 100% source segregation (pp.8-9); waste destinations and any bank-side dumping are not reported.
Solid waste for T. Narasipura appears in neither the Action Plan nor the MPRs - the reporting gap is the finding.

categories.label: Biomedical Waste

actionPlan.summary: Biomedical waste does not appear in the Kabini Action Plan.
actionPlan.cite: Kabini Action Plan (full text, zero mentions)

mpr.summary: No biomedical-waste reporting for T. Narasipura in any edition through September 2025; the stretch section's figure covers Nanjangud only.

gaps: No known public biomedical-waste figure for this town.

categories.label: Fecal Sludge

actionPlan.summary: Faecal sludge and septage do not appear in the Action Plan.

mpr.summary: Not reported in any edition through September 2025.

gaps: Half the town sits outside the UGD; that share's septage route is unreported, in the town where the stretch's worst BOD is measured.

mpr.summary: No private STP reporting for T. Narasipura in any edition through September 2025.

regions.name: Nanjangud industrial areas (KIADB, Thandya / Adakanahalli)
regions.inBasinNote: Sugar, distillery, steel, paper, pharmaceutical, food-processing and textile units concentrated in the taluk's industrial areas.

categories.label: Industrial effluent

actionPlan.summary: The plan asserts every industry in the taluk has an ETP, treats its effluent, and uses treated water on-land within premises - 'no industries are discharging into the river'.

mpr.summary: August 2025: 38 water-polluting industries, 9.03 MLD effluent, 38 ETPs (9.43 MLD capacity) all reported complied; CETP nil at every status. The KIADB Thandya/Adakanahalli estates are not named in the August stretch section at all - the zero-discharge position rests entirely on the ETP compliance table.

gaps: The zero-discharge claim is the board's own assertion, unverified by any published effluent data - for a sugar/distillery/pharma cluster upstream of a Priority-IV stretch, that is the matrix's biggest open question.
No OCEMS-style public feed exists for these units to check the claim against.

regions.name: Gram Panchayats (Kabini stretch)
regions.inBasinNote: The rural reach between the three towns on the 2025 stretch.
regions.silentNote: No MPR edition and no Action Plan item reports anything at gram-panchayat level for this stretch - the rural reach is unreported in the official accountability trail.
